name: insulin receptor substrate 1

function.text: IRS1 encodes insulin receptor substrate 1. Annotated molecular activities include signaling adaptor activity and signaling receptor complex adaptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: IRS1 encodes insulin receptor substrate 1. Based in part on similarity, it plays therefore an important role in development, growth, glucose homeostasis as well as lipid metabolism. Activation of the PI3K/AKT pathway is responsible for most of insulin metabolic effects in the cell, and the Ras/Raf/MEK/MAPK is involved in the regulation of gene expression and in cooperation with the PI3K pathway regulates cell growth and differentiation. It acts a positive regulator of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway through suppression of DVL2 autophagy-mediated degradation leading to cell proliferation.
